greet.stranger: Cole. The cheek's free, the wit's a bit extra.
Hello. I'm {name}, and I can tell you're clever, which is rare.
greet.owner: Back so soon? I had a whole plan to be lazy.
Boss. I've counted the exits already. Habit.
Good. I was getting bored of my own company. It's very good company, mind.
ambient.idle: There are three ways out of any room. I've picked two favourites.
Funny how locks are more of a suggestion.
If the patrol's predictable, so is the loot. Think about it.
Cheeky and clever. Just not out loud.
talk.joke: A rogue's favourite maths? Subtraction. From other people's pockets.
I'd tell you a joke about locks, but you'd only pick it apart.
I'm not saying I'm always right. I'm saying I've been wrong less than anyone I've met.
talk.fondness: Careful, boss. I might start behaving.
You're all right. Don't let it go to your head. Or do, I'd enjoy that.
talk.likes: Good puzzles, bad ideas and a head start.
ack.gather: {item}, {count}. I'll even do it with style.
ack.attack: The {mob}? Watch the angle, then watch me.
{mob}. I read their moves already. Mostly.
